```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
print(arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    categories |> dplyr::rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  dplyr::select(description, launch_date, consensus) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "field",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = list(value = as.character)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(field) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    missing_n = sum(is.na(value)),
    missing_pct = mean(is.na(value)) * 100
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = dplyr::coalesce(
      lubridate::ymd(launch_date, quiet = TRUE),
      lubridate::mdy(launch_date, quiet = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  dplyr::select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::select(market_cap_str) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  dplyr::summarise(missing_pct = mean(is.na(market_cap_str)) * 100)
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::filter(date >= as.Date("2025-01-01")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(coin_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
#| label: crypto-market-cap
#| message: false

crypto_market_cap <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(
    category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(
    market_cap_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap)
  )

ggplot(
  crypto_market_cap,
  aes(x = date, y = market_cap_share, fill = category_name)
) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Cryptocurrency Market-Cap Share by Category",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Total Market Cap",
    fill = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
